_help: Copy to sites/<site>.json. Keys starting with _ are notes. Every check follows the journey exactly, so keep it to the standard steps.
_banner_help: Before consent and Home are added by the runner. Accept/Reject: CSS selectors of the cookie banner buttons. OneTrust's are tried anyway, and Cookie settings › Reject All when there's no Reject button.
_gtm_loader_help: Where the site loads GTM from. Keep the default unless GTM is served from your own domain (server-side GTM / custom loader) - then add that path, e.g. "metrics\\.mysite\\.com/gtm\\.js".
_product_help: By default the cheapest product on the category page that can be added to the basket is tested (release file: product = "cheapest"). product_index is the tile used with product = "first" (0 = the first). price_selector (optional) is the CSS selector of the price inside a tile, if prices aren't found. The first check's product is reused by later checks.
_journey_help: After Home: Category opens a URL, Product clicks a tile (click_random picks the agreed product), Add to basket clicks on the product page, Basket opens a URL, Checkout clicks. Extra entries with "step": "Checkout" become part of that step. Don't add a Purchase step: with purchase = "yes" in the release file the tester places the order by hand after Checkout.
_noise_help: Events a noise test showed differ between two identical runs ("Vendor:event"). Left out of every report for this site and listed under Not compared.
_optional_help: A journey entry with "optional": true is skipped when it can't be done, e.g. a pop-up that doesn't always show.
